section_summary.extract_value: This section details a study examining creative achievement, specifically how semantic distance values predicted participants' log CAQ scores. It found that semantic distance significantly predicted CAQ scores in the cued condition (β = .18, p < .05) but not the uncued condition, indicating that higher creative achievement correlated with more creative verb responses. An exploratory analysis also revealed significant positive correlations between semantic distance values and CAQ scores in the science and visual art domains for cued nouns, and in the creative writing domain for uncued nouns, all within the same group of participants (N=179).
